egress.terms: Unlimited speed, download without login: homepage '不限速 / 下载免登录'. Caveat from a secondary source: non-members need to log in to download shared files larger than 100 MB.

tooling: OpenList driver `ilanzou` (reverse-engineered, explicitly unmaintained: '本接口是基于历史产物的逆向接口，项目组不会主动进行维护'); qaiu/netdisk-fast-download `iz` parser; HeriHeriCloud treats the Lanzou family as its storage substrate.
chaining: 2 TB per verified account, expiring in 12 months — so treat as '2 TB renewable annually per identity', not a permanent tier. 10 GB/file is the classic-Lanzou escape (classic caps at 100 MB).

identity_cost.detail: country-phone or email (绑定手机或邮箱 unlocks the 2 TB).

reliability_note: Two-tier product (classic vs 优享) with repeated policy narrowing — IT之家 reported APK sharing moved behind the ¥9/mo paywall. Unmaintained OpenList driver means the API can rot.
